office_does: The prosecuting attorney decides which crimes are charged and what plea offers are made in Yakima County, tries criminal cases for the state, and serves as the county government's lawyer.
race_blurb: An open seat between two Republicans who both prosecuted in the office's special assault unit: Tyler Haueter, endorsed by the county Republican Party, pledges no plea-downs for gang violence; Quinn Dalan, endorsed by the Mainstream Republicans, the deputies' guild and retired judges, stresses experience as prosecutor, defender and pro tem judge. The county party ran a months-long campaign against Dalan.

candidates.summary: Kennewick assistant city attorney and former Yakima County special-assault prosecutor running on an enforcement-first platform with the county Republican Party's endorsement.
highlights: Pledges no plea-downs for gang violence and every available sentencing enhancement [S2]
Would end 'soft-on-crime' plea deals for repeat and violent offenders [S2][S3]
Air Force paralegal, defense investigator, then special-assault prosecutor; now prosecutes in Kennewick [S1][S2]
Endorsed by the Yakima County Republican Party [S1]

safety.basis: Repeated explicit pledges: no plea-downs for gang violence, full prosecution of repeat offenders, every sentencing enhancement, 'enforce the law firmly ... without apology'.

experience.basis: Nearly 19 years in the criminal-justice system and current trial work, but a first-time candidate with a shorter career as a lawyer.

candidates.summary: Yakima lawyer since 2008: former deputy prosecutor and unit supervisor, public defender, legal-aid director and current municipal prosecutor for Wapato, Granger and Zillah.
highlights: Former special-assault prosecutor and District Court unit supervisor; cites 65+ trials [S1]
Has also worked as a public defender and pro tem judge [S2][S4]
Endorsed by the Mainstream Republicans, the sheriff's deputies' guild and retired judges [S3]
Target of a months-long county Republican Party campaign questioning her party loyalty [S4]

safety.basis: Prioritizes violent crime and drug trafficking, accountability and law-enforcement partnerships, while citing a balanced view from defense and judicial work.

experience.basis: Eighteen years practicing in Yakima County across prosecution, supervision, defense, civil legal aid, pro tem judging and current municipal prosecution.
